case_name: Single-pass direct-downlink finite-key reference reproduction fixture
reporting_class: descriptive modeled result and internal reproduction evidence
baseline_status: research baseline candidate; internally validated; not approved
gate_state: ARCH-G1, SCI-G1, and SIM-G1 are not passed

release_control.rule: Technical completeness never grants release authority.

claim_boundary: This is a reference-study reproduction fixture, not a Q-Orbit flight design or mission case.

The author-distributed modeled reference curve was constructed from an empirically derived channel and system model; it is not raw measurement data, an ephemeris, or an authorized Q-Orbit site record.
The retained study inputs are not adopted as Q-Orbit hardware specifications or approved cryptographic parameters.
The result does not establish operational security, mission feasibility, certification, approval, availability, or implementation security.
No real Q-Orbit orbit, ground-site coordinate, weather record, optical terminal, detector, authentication construction, entropy source, or EKM implementation is represented.
The numerical comparison is a separate internal reimplementation compared with retained author code; it is not independent third-party verification or validation.

time_and_channel.time_coordinate: integer seconds relative to maximum elevation; t=0 at peak
time_and_channel.window_selection_rule: exhaustive integer sweep; maximize floored finite secret-key length for otherwise frozen inputs; choose the smaller half-window on an exact tie

qkd_profile.family: prepare-and-measure efficient BB84 with phase-randomized weak coherent pulses
qkd_profile.multiplier_rationale: unity bookkeeping multipliers prevent double-counting because the distributed curve aggregates nominal electro-optical effects; they are not physical efficiency claims
qkd_profile.error_correction_model: Tomamichel et al. finite-block logM expression as implemented by retained SatQuMA v1.0.0
qkd_profile.phase_randomization: ideal method assumption; not device evidence
qkd_profile.protocol_parameter_mode: fixed author-example values; not globally optimized or approved by Q-Orbit
